branch_activations.carrier: Hudan carries the ordinary guidance and way-showing branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The making clause assigns hudan, and the following phrase names its beneficiary.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Gentle direction supplies the function assigned.” The local result and beneficiary frame gives that direction a recipient.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Guidance becomes the directing link between the Book and the lineage.
branch_activations.boundary: This keeps hudan as guidance; it does not claim that a different lexical sense replaces it.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: oğul ve kız bağı, çocuk edinme ve kaynağa dayalı adlandırma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişinin oğul veya kız olarak anne babasıyla taşıdığı gerçek çocukluk ve soy bağı.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: Benefactive li and the completing proper name identify a continuing recipient group.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The chain’s endpoint is read as a continuing lineage rather than a single recipient.
branch_activations.boundary: The lineage branch is local; extension through generations is the attributed synthesis.

findings.title: an attributed reading lets the Book form a lived course
findings.claim: An attributed reading lets the Book operate as a binding norm and practiced course that helps constitute the named lineage as a guided people.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace connects Book, assigned status, direction, and recipient lineage; its before-reading is guidance as information for an existing audience, while its after-reading treats the Book as an enacted course.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive guidance not only as content delivered to a group but as a pattern of practice that shapes communal life.
findings.containment: This remains an attributed, qualified reading. Banī still means descendants here; social construction is an added analogy, not the lexical meaning of the word or a claim that the verse describes a historical process.

epistemic.reason: The local Book, assignment, guidance, and lineage words are independently present, while their binding-norm and social-construction sequence comes from the reconstructed legacy_unbound trace.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bağlayıcı olarak hükme bağlama ve belirleme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir işi yapılması gereken bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük olarak belirlemek temel değerlerden biridir.
branch_activations.carrier: Al-kitāb is the carrier for the nominated branch of binding determination.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The immediately following prohibitive command supplies a local obligation frame.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Fixing a judgment or obligation makes the Book operative rather than merely textual.” The adjacent command offers a focus-local trigger for an operative norm.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Book can be sensed as carrying a binding rule, not only written content.
branch_activations.boundary: No specific legal rule or obligation beyond the local prohibition is specified.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: birini veya şeyi belirli bir duruma getirme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Var olan bir katılımcının durumunu, niteliğini veya konumunu değiştiren ettirici işlemi bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: Jaʿalnāhu carries the branch of assigning a state or function.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The result complement hudan names the function assigned.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Assigning a status installs that operative norm as guidance.” The complement supplies the local assigned status.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The norm is read as installed as guidance.
branch_activations.boundary: No exclusive object antecedent is selected.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir işin yönünü, hedefini ve izlenen doğrultusunu bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: Hudan carries a direction, course, or way to be followed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The assignment construction and named beneficiary make an applied course locally salient.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “A course, manner, and direction turn norm into communal practice.” The result complement follows the assigning verb and is directed to the named community.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Guidance can be read as a practiced communal course.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the word’s ordinary guidance sense is displaced.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: parçaları birleştirerek yapı kurma, kurulan yapı ve kurmaya olanak sağlama
branch_activations.facet_statement: Parçaları birbirine ekleyerek düzenli ve ayakta duran bir bütün kurma eylemi.
branch_activations.carrier: Banī is the focus carrier for the nominated building-by-joining-parts branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The Book and its assigned guidance function provide the proposed social relation.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Building by joining parts supplies the social construction of the recipient group.” This is a figurative extension from the named group in a guidance relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The community can be sensed as formed through a shared course.
branch_activations.boundary: The surface noun remains descendants/lineage; social formation is not its lexical gloss.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: oğul ve kız bağı, çocuk edinme ve kaynağa dayalı adlandırma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişinin oğul veya kız olarak anne babasıyla taşıdığı gerçek çocukluk ve soy bağı.
branch_activations.carrier: Banī also carries the branch’s ordinary genealogical descent.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The proper name Isrāʾīl completes the lineage phrase.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Genealogical descent keeps that constructed group anchored in the stated sons.” The construct relation grounds the building analogy in an actual named lineage.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The community-building resonance remains anchored in the stated descendants.
branch_activations.boundary: The metaphor does not erase or replace the direct lineage reading.

findings.title: an attributed encounter hinge joins gift and reception
findings.claim: An attributed local reading makes encounter the hinge between the given Book and guidance, while leaving the encounter suffix open among Book, Moses, and reception-related routes.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace places giving before liqāʾ, connects the encounter noun with reception, and lets a guide-at-the-front branch keep Moses as one possible embodied referent; the stated after-reading therefore reframes the clause as a transfer-to-reception hinge.
findings.reader_payoff: The prohibition can be felt as guarding an encounter or reception that connects the earlier gift to the later guidance.
findings.containment: The suffix is not disambiguated; no route through 32:10 is activated. The HFT root/branch roles remain attributed because its reconstructed source has broader-than-pericope scope and supplies no target morphology.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus Arabic and trusted QAC carriers are present, but the encounter sequence and guide-role synthesis come from a reconstructed legacy_unbound HFT record.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey bir alıcıya verilir.
branch_activations.carrier: Atāna carries the ordinary gift or transfer sense.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The Book is the named object given before the encounter term appears.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Giving supplies an offered object before it is received.” The focus clause provides that transfer sequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The encounter can be read after an offered Book, not in isolation.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace does not prove a single receiver or resolve the later suffix.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İki kişi veya şey karşı karşıya gelir ya da biri ötekiyle rastlaşır.
branch_activations.carrier: Liqāʾ carries the ordinary meeting or face-to-face encounter branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: It stands between the Book’s giving and the later assignment of guidance.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Two sides coming face to face makes encounter the transfer hinge.” The local sequence supplies the nominated transfer-to-encounter relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Encounter becomes a hinge joining gift and guidance.
branch_activations.boundary: The clause does not specify the encounter’s participants.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sözü aktarıp öğretme veya birinden alıp öğrenme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir söz veya okuma içeriği konuşandan ya da öğretenden alıcıya aktarılır.
branch_activations.carrier: Liqāʾ also carries the branch’s transfer-of-speech or reading-content field.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The Book has just been given and remains a local textual trigger.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Receiving and learning speech lets meeting include reception of the Book’s discourse.” The preceding Book supplies the proposed content.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Encounter can include a reception-of-discourse resonance.
branch_activations.boundary: No explicit speech, lesson, or reading event is narrated.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sözü aktarıp öğretme veya birinden alıp öğrenme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Alıcı kişi sözleri veya metni başkasından alır, öğrenir ve benimser.
branch_activations.carrier: The reception branch includes a recipient taking in and learning words or text.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The Book is the focus-local object that could be received as content.
branch_activations.activation: The HFT extension keeps the reader-side act of receiving in view alongside the noun’s direct meeting sense.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Book-reception remains a compatible local route.
branch_activations.boundary: This attributed route does not force reception as the single reading.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir şeyin ilk veya öndeki bölümü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir bütünün ilk veya önde bulunan bölümü ya da üyesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: Hudan is the focus carrier nominated for the branch of a front or leading part.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Moses and the Book are both local antecedent possibilities around the later object suffix.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “A guide at the front keeps Moses as a possible embodied antecedent beside the Book.” The focus allows this as a referential possibility, not a resolution.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A guide embodied as Moses can remain alongside the Book as a possible referent.
branch_activations.boundary: No choice between Moses and the Book is made.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir şeyin ilk veya öndeki bölümü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Önden ilerleyen değnek veya kılavuz, önde bulunma yoluyla başkasına yön gösterir.
branch_activations.carrier: Hudan can evoke the associated branch of a guide that leads from the front.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The named Moses and the Book supply the two locally open referential routes.
branch_activations.activation: The HFT’s guide-at-the-front association keeps an embodied guide available while preserving the focus word’s guidance sense.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Moses remains a possible embodied guide beside a Book-centered reading.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an attributed association, not a claim that hudan literally names Moses.

findings.title: an exploratory reading pictures doubt as inhabited wavering
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the locative command can picture doubt as an inhabited back-and-forth that prevents encounter from settling.
findings.mechanism: The attributed trace links being/position, ordinary doubt, a separate wavering branch, and face-to-face encounter; its before-reading is intellectual uncertainty, while its after-reading renders that uncertainty as unsettled motion.
findings.reader_payoff: A reader may feel the prohibition as a call not to remain lodged in hesitation that keeps reception or encounter from becoming steady.
findings.containment: This remains an exploratory image beside ordinary doubt, not a replacement lexical definition. The motion mapping is attributed and the focus morphology is not independently supplied by the HFT source.

epistemic.reason: Trusted root occurrences confirm focus contact, but the wavering-to-encounter synthesis is from a reconstructed legacy_unbound record and remains exploratory.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin bulunduğu yer veya durduğu nokta çekirdek alandır.
branch_activations.carrier: Takun is the carrier for the branch’s location and position value.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The verb is followed by the explicit locative phrase fī miryah.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Place and station make uncertainty an inhabited condition.” The local fī phrase makes the position image available.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Doubt can be pictured as a condition in which one is lodged.
branch_activations.boundary: The place image is figurative and does not replace the copular sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin bir şey veya konu hakkında kesin bir yargıya ulaşamaması temel kuşku durumudur.
branch_activations.carrier: Miryah carries the direct doubt or hesitation branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The locative construction places the doubt noun under the being-verb.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Doubt and hesitation supply the explicit uncertain state.” The surface word independently anchors the core state.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Ordinary doubt remains the ground for the image.
branch_activations.boundary: The exploratory motion reading does not displace the ordinary doubt sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey enine doğrultuda gidip gelir, salınır veya dalga benzeri bir hareket gösterir.
branch_activations.carrier: Miryah is the focus carrier for the HFT’s separately mapped wavering branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The locative state construction and the encounter noun create the proposed motion-to-encounter relation.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “The alternate mapped motion of wavering back and forth spatializes that hesitation.” This is kept as an exploratory image only.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Doubt may be imagined as wavering that obstructs a settled encounter.
branch_activations.boundary: This mapped motion is not asserted as the lexical meaning of miryah.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İki kişi veya şey karşı karşıya gelir ya da biri ötekiyle rastlaşır.
branch_activations.carrier: Liqāʾ carries the direct face-to-face encounter branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The doubt state is the local condition set against a stable encounter.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Face-to-face convergence is the stable event that oscillation obstructs.” The encounter is the nominated endpoint of the image.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The wavering image is felt as preventing encounter from settling.
branch_activations.boundary: The phrase does not state that an encounter fails to happen.

findings.title: an exploratory image treats doubt as proof-extraction
findings.claim: As an exploratory image only, doubt can feel like repeatedly pressing an expected encounter for proof before receiving it.
findings.mechanism: The attributed trace links the doubt-root extraction branch to being in a state and to the expected convergence of liqāʾ; it shifts the source’s before-reading of passive uncertainty to an image of active extraction.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader may notice the strain of demanding advance proof from an encounter one has not yet received.
findings.containment: Ordinary doubt remains fully intact. The extraction branch is materially distant and its registry boundary excludes equating it with ordinary miryah; use only as-if imagery, never as lexical etymology or as a claim that the verse asserts missing proof.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus root records support carrier contact, but the extractive image comes from a reconstructed legacy_unbound outlier and its own containment requires an as-if boundary.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ovup içteki akışı veya gücü ortaya çıkarma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Sağım öncesinde devenin memesini elle ovmak, süt akışını başlatmaya yönelik bir işlemdir.
branch_activations.carrier: Miryah is the surface carrier nominated for the branch of rubbing to draw out an inner flow or yield.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The locative state and encounter term provide the HFT’s proposed posture and object of proof-seeking.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “Repeated pressing to draw out yield supplies an image of compulsive proof-extraction.” The branch is activated only in the source’s bounded as-if image.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Doubt may be imagined as over-pressing the expected encounter for proof.
branch_activations.boundary: The registry explicitly excludes treating extraction as the ordinary lexical sense of miryah.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin bulunduğu yer veya durduğu nokta çekirdek alandır.
branch_activations.carrier: Takun supplies the focus carrier for the branch’s location or station value.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The locative fī miryah phrase names the state in which the addressee is not to remain.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “An inhabited station turns that repeated extraction into a settled posture.” The locative syntax supplies the image’s posture.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The as-if image becomes a settled stance of extracting proof.
branch_activations.boundary: The locative metaphor is not a literal place or proof that any encounter is absent.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İki kişi veya şey karşı karşıya gelir ya da biri ötekiyle rastlaşır.
branch_activations.carrier: Liqāʾ carries the direct encounter or convergence sense.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The doubt phrase governs this expected encounter as its object.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed HFT role: “The expected convergence is what the reader keeps pressing for advance evidence.” The focus min phrase gives the encounter as the object of doubt.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The image frames doubt as seeking advance proof of encounter before reception.
branch_activations.boundary: The encounter remains an open object; this analogy does not settle its referent.

friction_notes: The micro packet has no selected context units and an empty connection registry, so findings use only 32:23 focus surfaces. The support pointer to 32:10 is recorded as excluded rather than imported as a trigger.

All five HFT nominations contact the exact Arabic of 32:23, but they come from one reconstructed legacy_unbound reader whose packet scope is broader than the declared pericope and whose target morphology is not supplied. Their branch roles and before/after shifts are retained as attributed; the oscillation and extraction images remain exploratory.

The packet contains no staged reader responses, reader walks, or explicit semantic-obligation array. Semantic-obligation references therefore remain empty, while the HFT source's own before/after changes are preserved in attributed findings.
The opening support invokes an earlier warning or retribution without supplying that antecedent surface; only the local resumptive and emphatic sequence is retained.
